Name: Another Hunger Mod
Author: spacechase0
Description:
[b]Another Hunger Mod [/b]adds a hunger system to the game.

[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url]﻿.
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b][size=5]Use[/size][/b]
You have a fullness cap of 100, which reduces by 0.8 points every 10 minutes. Eating food restores fullness based on its edibility value, which is what the game uses to calculate stamina and health restored. (Essentially, the more stamina it restores, the more fullness it restores.)

Your fullness provides buffs or debuffs:
[list]
[*][b]Over 80:[/b] improved speed and attack.
[*][b]Below 25:[/b] reduced speed.
[*][b]Zero:[/b] starvation damage over time.
[/list]
You also need to feed your spouse each day. Forgetting to feed them will reduce friendship by 50 points per day.

[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.5+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.
